name: What are the signs of a gas leak in my home?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a gas leak in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recognizing the signs of a gas leak is crucial for safety. Common indicators include a distinctive sulfur or rotten egg smell, which is added to natural gas for detection. You might also hear a hissing or whistling sound near a gas line or appliance. Other signs can be visual, such as a damaged gas pipe or a white cloud near a gas line. If plants indoors or outdoors suddenly die or appear unhealthy near a gas line, this could also indicate a leak. Any of these signs warrant immediate attention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a rotten egg smell, hissing sounds, damaged pipes, or unexplained dying plants near gas lines.
